Teach the hand skill shown in this recording.

RECORDED DEMONSTRATION (measured by the gloves):
Recording title: Worn Smartgloves II capture, left hand.
Demonstrating hand: left. Duration 25.1 s, 67 glove samples. The recorder cut it into 4 step(s) at the moments the hand was still.
Finger travel over the whole take (flexion range, degrees): thumb 37, index 69, middle 75, ring 66, little 52.
Steps, in order:
1. Step 1 (held still, 6.3 s): thumb half bent, index straight, middle straight, ring straight, little half bent. Most bent: little at 26 degrees. Picture: step_00.jpg.
2. Step 2 (held still, 6.3 s): thumb half bent, index curled, middle curled, ring curled, little curled. Most bent: middle at 83 degrees. Picture: step_01.jpg.
3. Step 3 (held still, 6.3 s): thumb half bent, index straight, middle straight, ring straight, little half bent. Most bent: little at 28 degrees. Picture: step_02.jpg.
4. Step 4 (held still, 6.3 s): thumb half bent, index straight, middle half bent, ring curled, little half bent. Most bent: ring at 55 degrees. Picture: step_03.jpg.

steps.title: Lesson 1: Open Hand
steps.instruction: Keep your index, middle, and ring fingers straight while slightly bending your thumb and little finger.

steps.title: Lesson 2: Closed Fist
steps.instruction: Curl your index, middle, ring, and little fingers tightly into your palm.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Partial Grip
steps.instruction: Keep your index finger straight and curl your ring finger, while slightly bending the others.
